proof:
Conventions: ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) = Eucl P with norm |·|; Hⁿ = μHE[n] (Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure, = μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)); on ℝⁿ, Hⁿ = Lⁿ = volume (`EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume`). B̄_ρ(y) = closedBall y ρ. η_{y,λ}(x) = λ⁻¹(x − y) is `Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y λ`. ∫_A f dHⁿ is the Bochner set integral (0 when f is not integrable on A); ∫⁻ is the [0,∞]-valued lintegral. 'T is the approximate tangent space of S at y' means `Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S y T` (Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.4): finrank T = n and ∫_{η_{y,λ}(S)} φ dHⁿ → ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+ for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ). `HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ y T` (Def. 1.7) means finrank T = n and ∫_{η_{y,λ}(M)} φ(z) θ(y + λz) dHⁿ(z) → θ(y) ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+ for every φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ).

This is the main computation of step 2 of the parent proof (Simon, proof of Theorem 1.6 "⇒": ∫_{η(M)} f = ∫_{η(N_j)} f − ∫_{η(N_j∖M_j)} f + ∫_{η(M∖M_j)} f with both error terms controlled by the Upper Density Theorem). It uses the sibling result
 (BLOWUP) for λ > 0, any S and any g: ∫_{η_{y,λ}(S)} g dHⁿ = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_S g(η_{y,λ}(x)) dHⁿ(x).
Let μ := μHE[n] on ℝ^Q.

1. (Dimension.) finrank T = n is part of the hypothesis that T is the approximate tangent space of N at y.

2. (Set-up.) Fix φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ); choose R > 0 with tsupport φ ⊆ B̄_R(0) and put A := sup|φ|. For ρ > 0 let q₁(ρ) := μ((C ∖ N) ∩ B̄_ρ(y))/ofReal(ρⁿ) and q₂(ρ) := μ((N ∖ C) ∩ B̄_ρ(y))/ofReal(ρⁿ) in [0, ∞]. The map λ ↦ λR tends to 0 within (0, ∞) as λ → 0+, so by hypothesis q₁(λR) → 0 and q₂(λR) → 0 as λ → 0+. Hence for all sufficiently small λ > 0: λR < r and q₁(λR) < 1, so μ((C ∖ N) ∩ B̄_{λR}(y)) < ofReal((λR)ⁿ) < ∞.

3. (Localization.) Fix such a λ and put η := η_{y,λ}, B := B̄_{λR}(y). If φ(η(x)) ≠ 0 then η(x) ∈ tsupport φ ⊆ B̄_R(0), i.e. |x − y| ≤ λR: so φ∘η vanishes outside B. By (BLOWUP), ∫_{η(C)} φ dHⁿ = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_C φ∘η dμ and ∫_{η(N)} φ dHⁿ = (λⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_N φ∘η dμ; and since φ∘η = 0 off B, ∫_C φ∘η dμ = ∫_{C∩B} φ∘η dμ and ∫_N φ∘η dμ = ∫_{N∩B} φ∘η dμ.

4. (Decomposition.) Let P₀ := C ∩ N ∩ B, P₁ := (C ∖ N) ∩ B, P₂ := (N ∖ C) ∩ B. They are μ-null-measurable (C, N null-measurable, B closed), C ∩ B = P₀ ∪ P₁ and N ∩ B = P₀ ∪ P₂ are disjoint unions, and all have finite measure: μ(P₀), μ(P₂) ≤ μ(N ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ (λR < r) and μ(P₁) < ∞ (step 2). Since φ∘η is continuous and bounded by A, it is μ-integrable on each P_k. By additivity of the set integral over disjoint null-measurable sets,
 ∫_{C∩B} φ∘η dμ − ∫_{N∩B} φ∘η dμ = ∫_{P₁} φ∘η dμ − ∫_{P₂} φ∘η dμ, and |∫_{P_k} φ∘η dμ| ≤ A · μ(P_k).toReal (k = 1, 2).

5. (Estimate.) Combining steps 3 and 4 and using (λR)ⁿ = λⁿRⁿ:
 |∫_{η_{y,λ}(C)} φ dHⁿ − ∫_{η_{y,λ}(N)} φ dHⁿ| ≤ A (λⁿ)⁻¹ (μ(P₁) + μ(P₂)).toReal = A Rⁿ (q₁(λR) + q₂(λR)).toReal.
 Since q₁(λR) + q₂(λR) → 0 in [0, ∞] and ENNReal.toReal is continuous at 0 (on finite values), the right side tends to 0 as λ → 0+.

6. (Conclusion.) By hypothesis ∫_{η_{y,λ}(N)} φ dHⁿ → ∫_T φ dHⁿ, hence by step 5 ∫_{η_{y,λ}(C)} φ dHⁿ → ∫_T φ dHⁿ as λ → 0+. As φ ∈ C_c(ℝ^Q, ℝ) was arbitrary, together with step 1 this shows that T is the approximate tangent space of C at y (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T). ∎
key_steps: finrank T = n is inherited from N.
For φ with tsupport φ ⊆ B̄_R(0), φ∘η_{y,λ} vanishes off B̄_{λR}(y); BLOWUP turns blow-up integrals of C and N into λ^{−n} times integrals over C ∩ B̄_{λR}(y), N ∩ B̄_{λR}(y).
Split C ∩ B and N ∩ B into C∩N∩B plus (C∖N)∩B, resp. (N∖C)∩B (finite measures for small λ); the difference of the integrals is bounded by sup|φ| · λ^{−n}[Hⁿ((C∖N)∩B) + Hⁿ((N∖C)∩B)].
This bound equals sup|φ| Rⁿ (q₁ + q₂)(λR) → 0, so blow-ups of C converge to ∫_T φ.
